tools.name: apifleet_get_provider_matrix
tools.description: Public, no key: discover implemented voice and carrier integrations, setup boundaries, platform pricing and documentation. No provider request or call is made.

tools.name: apifleet_estimate_call_cost
tools.description: Public, no key: calculate USD platform fees plus caller-supplied blended provider/carrier rates. An estimate, not a provider quote or invoice. Does not place a call.

tools.name: apifleet_check_assistant_config
tools.description: Public, no key: seven static configuration checks. Send a redacted configuration without secrets or customer data. No save, credential verification, full API validation or call-quality certification occurs.

tools.name: check_entitlements
tools.description: Read the workspace prepaid balance and funding path. Does not start a checkout or call.

tools.name: list_assistants
tools.description: List assistants in the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: get_assistant
tools.description: Get one assistant belonging to this workspace.

tools.name: create_assistant
tools.description: Create a assistant. Saving configuration does not place a call. The REST response includes revision, configuration and attached resource identifiers.

tools.name: update_assistant
tools.description: Update selected assistant fields. Omitted fields retain their values.

tools.name: delete_assistant
tools.description: Delete this assistant. Review the identifier before deleting; the change cannot be undone.

tools.name: set_assistant_tools
tools.description: Replace all attached HTTP tools with existing tools owned by this workspace. Empty tool_ids detaches every tool.

tools.name: set_assistant_knowledge
tools.description: Replace all attached knowledge documents. Each document must belong to this workspace.

tools.name: create_browser_test_token
tools.description: Issue a short-lived browser voice-test URL. Opening its WebSocket can incur usage. Never publish the returned token.

tools.name: list_numbers
tools.description: List number bindings. This does not buy phone numbers from a carrier.

tools.name: bind_number
tools.description: Bind an existing carrier number to a workspace assistant. This changes incoming call routing; configure the carrier webhook separately.

tools.name: unbind_number
tools.description: Remove the routing binding. This does not release or cancel the carrier number.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: Read call logs, summary statistics and pagination. Each row may contain transcript, analysis, costs and recording links; recordings require separate authentication.

tools.name: create_outbound_call
tools.description: Place a real telephone call. Ask the user to approve recipient, caller number and expected usage first. Billing/provider/carrier checks are the same as REST. No automatic retry or universal idempotency guarantee.

tools.name: get_waveform
tools.description: Read recording waveform metadata and available audio channels.

tools.name: delete_recording
tools.description: Permanently remove a call recording. The call log remains. Confirm the identifier before deleting.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List http tools in the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get one tool belonging to this workspace.

tools.name: create_tool
tools.description: Create a tool. Creating a tool returns its signing secret once. Configuring a tool does not invoke its URL; attached tools can call it during conversations.

tools.name: update_tool
tools.description: Update selected tool fields. Omitted fields retain their values.

tools.name: delete_tool
tools.description: Delete this tool. Review the identifier before deleting; the change cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_knowledge_documents
tools.description: List knowledge in the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: get_knowledge_document
tools.description: Get one knowledge document belonging to this workspace.

tools.name: create_knowledge_document
tools.description: Create a knowledge document. Attach documents separately to use them in an assistant. Total injected knowledge has a 200 KiB limit.

tools.name: update_knowledge_document
tools.description: Update selected knowledge document fields. Omitted fields retain their values.

tools.name: delete_knowledge_document
tools.description: Delete this knowledge document. Review the identifier before deleting; the change cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhooks in the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook. Creation returns a signing secret once; verify delivery signatures against the raw body. Events may be retried.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Update selected webhook fields. Omitted fields retain their values.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete this webhook. Review the identifier before deleting; the change cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_simulation_personas
tools.description: List simulation personas in the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: get_simulation_persona
tools.description: Get one simulation persona belonging to this workspace.

tools.name: create_simulation_persona
tools.description: Create a simulation persona.

tools.name: update_simulation_persona
tools.description: Update selected simulation persona fields. Omitted fields retain their values.

tools.name: delete_simulation_persona
tools.description: Delete this simulation persona. Review the identifier before deleting; the change cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_simulation_scenarios
tools.description: List simulation scenarios in the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: get_simulation_scenario
tools.description: Get one simulation scenario belonging to this workspace.

tools.name: create_simulation_scenario
tools.description: Create a simulation scenario.

tools.name: update_simulation_scenario
tools.description: Update selected simulation scenario fields. Omitted fields retain their values.

tools.name: delete_simulation_scenario
tools.description: Delete this simulation scenario. Review the identifier before deleting; the change cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_simulations
tools.description: List simulations in the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: get_simulation
tools.description: Get one simulation belonging to this workspace.

tools.name: create_simulation
tools.description: Create a simulation.

tools.name: update_simulation
tools.description: Update selected simulation fields. Omitted fields retain their values.

tools.name: delete_simulation
tools.description: Delete this simulation. Review the identifier before deleting; the change cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_simulation_runs
tools.description: List simulation runs and pagination; inspect status before starting another run.

tools.name: get_simulation_run
tools.description: Read a run, its evaluations and linked call when available.

tools.name: delete_simulation_run
tools.description: Delete a completed simulation result. Running runs may reject deletion.

tools.name: start_simulation_run
tools.description: Queue an asynchronous test. Models and speech can incur usage. Approve the run first and poll the returned identifier; do not enqueue again while it is running.

tools.name: start_simulation_batch
tools.description: Queue every simulation for one assistant. This can incur multiple test runs; approve the batch first.

tools.name: list_tts_rates
tools.description: Read configured voice-cost reference rates. These are not an invoice or a complete call price.

tools.name: list_tts_voices
tools.description: Read a provider voice catalog using configured server-side credentials. Catalog failure may return an empty list and error; it is not evidence the provider has no voices.

tools.name: list_voice_presets
tools.description: Read configured runnable voice presets. Provider catalog requests may reach a vendor.

tools.name: get_assistant_voice_presets
tools.description: Read voices compatible with this assistant configuration.

tools.name: get_tts_settings
tools.description: Read supported provider voice settings and validation ranges.

tools.name: list_provider_credentials
tools.description: List which provider credentials are configured. Returns metadata only, never provider secret values.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List this workspace API-key metadata. Full key values cannot be retrieved.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create a new full workspace key. The secret is returned once. Store it privately; never put it in public client code.

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke a workspace API key immediately. Revoking the key in use disconnects this MCP client on its next request.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: Read available, reserved and total prepaid funds, policy, funding availability and runtime enforcement. Amounts ending in microusd are integer millionths of a USD.

tools.name: get_billing_policy
tools.description: Read the actual workspace policy. Internal exempt workspaces can differ from the public tariff.

tools.name: list_balance_activity
tools.description: Read balance activity and pagination cursor. Funding is credited only after verified payment processing.

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Read confirmed and pending workspace payment records for the configured live/test environment.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Read the authenticated workspace metrics snapshot. Metrics may reset with the application process and are not a complete billing ledger.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_calls · Private data: apifleet_check_assistant_config, set_assistant_knowledge, create_browser_test_token, create_tool, list_knowledge_documents, get_knowledge_document, create_knowledge_document, update_knowledge_document, delete_knowledge_document, create_webhook, list_tts_voices, list_provider_credentials, list_api_keys, create_api_key, revoke_api_key, get_wallet, list_payments · Public sink: apifleet_check_assistant_config, create_browser_test_token, bind_number, create_webhook, update_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_assistant, unbind_number, delete_recording, delete_tool, delete_knowledge_document, delete_webhook, delete_simulation_persona, delete_simulation_scenario, delete_simulation, list_simulation_runs, get_simulation_run, delete_simulation_run, start_simulation_run, get_metrics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_calls · Private data: apifleet_check_assistant_config, set_assistant_knowledge, create_browser_test_token, create_tool, list_knowledge_documents, get_knowledge_document, create_knowledge_document, update_knowledge_document, delete_knowledge_document, create_webhook, list_tts_voices, list_provider_credentials, list_api_keys, create_api_key, revoke_api_key, get_wallet, list_payments · Public sink: apifleet_check_assistant_config, create_browser_test_token, bind_number, create_webhook, update_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_assistant, unbind_number, delete_recording, delete_tool, delete_knowledge_document, delete_webhook, delete_simulation_persona, delete_simulation_scenario, delete_simulation, list_simulation_runs, get_simulation_run, delete_simulation_run, start_simulation_run, get_metrics

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
